text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The fan votes have been tallied, and<n>Grass Wonder
has earned a slot in<n>the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The showdown with Maruzensky is<n>at hand, and
Grass Wonder can<n>barely contain her excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Maruzensky suffers an<n>injury while
training and is forced to<n>withdraw from the race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What's more, Grass Wonder learns<n>that
Maruzensky had intended the<n>Arima Kinen to be
her last race in the<n>Twinkle Series.
